description: A Flutter UI screen for displaying quiz analytics, including KPIs and per-quiz performance breakdowns. It utilizes Riverpod providers to fetch and reactively update data.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A ConsumerWidget that displays quiz analytics data including KPIs and per-quiz statistics with refresh capabilities.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the analytics dashboard, reacting to data availability and errors.

methods.name: _kpiCard
methods.description: Creates a card widget showing a specific KPI with icon, value, and styling.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Creates a widget displaying statistics for a specific quiz, including attempts, average, best, and last scores.

methods.name: _miniBar
methods.description: Creates a small bar indicator for visual percentage representation.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Creates a pill-shaped label for statuses like 'Completed'.

methods.name: _emptyState
methods.description: Displays a message and button when no quiz attempts are recorded.
